reasoning_trace.value: The system uses an OTFS waveform based on photonics-assisted technology in a W-band fiber-wireless ISAC system. The OTFS signal is modulated in the delay-Doppler (DD) domain, which enhances the robustness of the signal against frequency-selective fading. A zero-padding two-dimensional discrete Fourier transform (ZP-2D-DFT) scheme is proposed for the OTFS-based photonics-assisted W-band fiber-wireless ISAC system.
